# Templatical Playground

> Live init() setups for the Templatical email editor SDK.

Each scene is also raw markdown: /scenes/<id>.md

## Minimum

- [Minimum setup](https://play.templatical.com/scenes/minimum): Empty canvas, nothing wired

## Configure

- [Fonts](https://play.templatical.com/scenes/fonts): Limit the type menu
- [Defaults](https://play.templatical.com/scenes/defaults): New blocks stay on-brand
- [Theming](https://play.templatical.com/scenes/theming): Paint the chrome your colors
- [Internationalization](https://play.templatical.com/scenes/i18n): German chrome and placeholders
- [Shadow DOM off](https://play.templatical.com/scenes/shadow-dom-off): Mount in the page light DOM
- [Issues](https://play.templatical.com/scenes/issues): Lint the template as you edit
- [Custom blocks](https://play.templatical.com/scenes/custom-blocks): Register your own block type

## Personalization

- [Merge tags](https://play.templatical.com/scenes/merge-tags): Insert a field from the list
- [Merge tags on request](https://play.templatical.com/scenes/merge-tags-on-request): Pick fields from your app
- [Merge tag samples](https://play.templatical.com/scenes/merge-tags-samples): Preview with sample values
- [Resolve preview](https://play.templatical.com/scenes/merge-tags-resolve-preview): Preview with real recipient data
- [Logic tags](https://play.templatical.com/scenes/logic-tags): Branch copy with IF / ENDIF
- [Display conditions](https://play.templatical.com/scenes/display-conditions): Hide a block per recipient

## Your backend

- [Templates](https://play.templatical.com/scenes/templates): Load and save the template
- [Version history](https://play.templatical.com/scenes/version-history): Restore an earlier snapshot
- [Comments](https://play.templatical.com/scenes/comments): Thread a note on a block
- [Saved blocks](https://play.templatical.com/scenes/saved-blocks): Bookmark a reusable group
- [Media](https://play.templatical.com/scenes/media): Upload and pick an image
- [Test email](https://play.templatical.com/scenes/test-email): Send this to an inbox
- [Render](https://play.templatical.com/scenes/render): Export MJML and HTML

## Import

- [Unlayer](https://play.templatical.com/scenes/import-unlayer): Paste Unlayer JSON
- [BeeFree](https://play.templatical.com/scenes/import-beefree): Paste BeeFree JSON
- [Stripo](https://play.templatical.com/scenes/import-stripo): Paste Stripo HTML
- [Topol](https://play.templatical.com/scenes/import-topol): Paste Topol JSON
- [Chamaileon](https://play.templatical.com/scenes/import-chamaileon): Paste Chamaileon JSON
- [Easy Email Pro](https://play.templatical.com/scenes/import-easy-email-pro): Paste Easy Email Pro JSON
- [MJML](https://play.templatical.com/scenes/import-mjml): Paste MJML source
- [HTML](https://play.templatical.com/scenes/import-html): Paste table-based HTML

## Examples

- [Launchpad launch](https://play.templatical.com/scenes/example-launchpad-launch): SaaS product launch email
- [Launchpad reset](https://play.templatical.com/scenes/example-launchpad-reset): Password reset, same brand
- [Flowwork welcome](https://play.templatical.com/scenes/example-flowwork-welcome): Onboarding with resolved tags
- [Flowwork newsletter](https://play.templatical.com/scenes/example-flowwork-newsletter): Weekly digest with curated fonts
- [Sable order](https://play.templatical.com/scenes/example-sable-order): Order receipt with sample values
- [Sable Friday](https://play.templatical.com/scenes/example-sable-friday): Sale with live HTML preview
- [Northstage event](https://play.templatical.com/scenes/example-northstage-event): Event invite, locked colors
- [Northstage Arabic](https://play.templatical.com/scenes/example-northstage-ar): Same invite, Arabic RTL
